meta.source: Extension of the supplied 'Kohl & Malachite' tokens.json (kept verbatim). Adds a controlled secondary palette for campaign and discovery surfaces; base tokens are never overridden.

color.note: Each hue ships four partners — <hue>-wash (lightest ground), <hue>-soft (surface), <hue> (fill / decoration), <hue>-ink (text on the wash or soft surface). Text never sits on a hue fill except on-rose. Malachite stays the ONLY action color: buttons, links and active states never take these hues.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Blush-rose accent fill: decorative shapes, campaign accents, rose badges. White text on it is 5.2:1 (on-rose). Never an action or error color.

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Blush surface: the rose atmosphere ground, rose badges, concern chips.

tokens.name: rose-wash
tokens.usage: Lightest blush ground; the light end of rose gradients.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on rose-wash, rose-soft, paper and paper-raised (≥7.4:1).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warm coral/peach fill: decorative shapes and campaign light. Text on it is ink (8:1); it is never used as text.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Peach surface: the peach atmosphere ground, peach badges.

tokens.name: peach-wash
tokens.usage: Lightest peach ground; the light end of peach gradients.

tokens.name: peach-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on peach-wash, peach-soft and paper (≥6.3:1). Distinct from henna, which stays reserved for offers.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Soft lilac fill: decorative shapes and campaign depth. Text on it is ink (4.6:1) — prefer no text.

tokens.name: lilac-soft
tokens.usage: Lilac surface: the lilac atmosphere ground, lilac badges.

tokens.name: lilac-wash
tokens.usage: Lightest lilac ground; the light end of lilac gradients.

tokens.name: lilac-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on lilac-wash, lilac-soft and paper (≥7.5:1).

tokens.name: saffron-wash
tokens.usage: Lightest saffron ground (partner of the existing saffron / saffron-soft / saffron-ink).

tokens.name: malachite-wash
tokens.usage: Lightest malachite ground (partner of malachite / malachite-soft / malachite-deep).

atmosphere.note: An atmosphere is a campaign mood. Put data-atmosphere="rose|peach|lilac|saffron|malachite" on a section or card and use bg-atm-wash / bg-atm-surface / text-atm-ink / bg-atm-accent. Navigation, typography, actions and feedback never change with the atmosphere. Without the attribute the neutral default applies.
